notes.title: Update 1.5.4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Today, we're releasing Update [b]v1.5.4[/b] for Desktop Dinosaurs, which focuses on addressing user-reported bugs, particularly those identified as the most critical and impactful, to ensure a smoother dinosaur caretaking adventure.

Thank you for your continuous support and feedback. A full list of changes in this update can be found below.

[h2]Release Notes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where eggshells would collide with dinosaurs or toys, resulting in unexpected behavior.
[*] Improved the dinosaur collider to prevent unintended interactions and collisions.
[*] Addressed multiple issues with evolution calculations, ensuring correct progression.
[*] Fixed dinosaurs getting stuck in two states. A 3-second cooldown has been added between states, and better state changes have been implemented to prevent dinosaurs from getting stuck in a loop of 2 states.
[*] Reworked the disabled state of tabs and buttons to fix transparency issues.
[*] Resolved issues with dinosaurs' animations, especially for the baby Stegosaur, ensuring they play correctly and smoothly.
[/list]
